userStories.title: The worktree API takes the identity

When `WorktreeManager.create` is given the identity derived for feature `f` and storyId `US-001`, a branch named `nax/story-f-US-001` is created.
When `WorktreeManager.remove` is given the identity derived for feature `f` and storyId `US-001`, the branch `nax/story-f-US-001` is removed.

When `MergeEngine.merge` is given the identity `story-f-US-001`, it invokes git with the branch name `nax/story-f-US-001`.
When `MergeEngine.mergeAll` returns a `MergeResult` for storyId `US-001`, that result carries `storyId` equal to the raw string `US-001`.
When `MergeEngine.mergeAll` orders two stories by a dependency map keyed by their raw story IDs, merging the dependency before the dependent, the dependency is merged before the dependent.

When `MergeEngine.mergeAll` is given a story whose raw-ID dependency failed in the same call, that story is reported with `success: false` and `failureKind: "error"` and not retried, reporting it unmerged.

When `WorktreeManager.create` is given the identity `story-f-US-001` and the branch `nax/story-f-US-001` already exists, it throws `NaxError` with code `WORKTREE_ERROR` and the thrown message names the composed branch `nax/story-f-US-001`.

In a repository with a linked git worktree, when story `US-001` for feature `a` is created from the main checkout and story `US-001` for feature `b` is created from the linked worktree, both `create()` calls resolve without throwing.
After the linked-worktree create above, the branch `nax/story-a-US-001` created from the main checkout still exists in the repository.
`deriveBakeoffWorktreeId("f", "agent")` returns the same string value as before this feature for the same inputs.

userStories.title: Every execution-layer site derives the identity
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Update the nine sites under `src/execution/` and the bakeoff worktree-path site that build a worktree path, branch string or orphan-ref string from a raw story ID, so each derives an identity from its run's feature, while metrics, costs and status keep the raw story ID.

**Motivation** — Composing only the parameter sites (US-002) leaves three silent failures: `src/execution/iteration-runner.ts:90` builds the path the story actually runs in (`:99` assigns it to `effectiveWorkdir`), so a composed `create()` beside a raw path means every sequential worktree-mode story runs in a directory that does not exist; `src/execution/pipeline-result-handler.ts:48` (`hasWorktree`) would return `false` for every composed worktree, so failed-story cleanup never fires and `recordNaxOrphanOwnership` is never called — silently disabling the BUG-28 Step-3 evidence path; `src/execution/pipeline-result-handler.ts:116` pairs a composed ref name with a raw `refs/heads/nax/<storyId>` source branch, so `git update-ref` names a branch that does not exist. The other sites — `src/execution/parallel-batch.ts:164`, `src/execution/merge-conflict-rectify.ts:272`, `src/execution/pipeline-result-handler.ts:68/:477`, `src/execution/lifecycle/run-initialization.ts:239/:254`, `src/bakeoff/contestant.ts:124` — are correctness gaps: a raw path/branch against a composed worktree cannot find what it is looking for.

**Approach** — Every execution-layer site that builds a worktree path or branch string derives an identity from its run's feature and reads the spelled string from US-001's producers. `runParallelBatch` derives `storyWorktreeId(feature, story.id)` for each story and calls `WorktreeManager.create`/`remove`/`MergeEngine.mergeAll` with the identity, mapping `worktreePaths` to `storyWorktreePath(workdir, worktreeId)`; the returned `completed` list is keyed by raw story ID and `storyCosts` is keyed by raw story ID. The iteration runner derives the identity from `ctx.feature`, calls `WorktreeManager.create` with the identity, and uses `storyWorktreePath(workdir, worktreeId)` for `effectiveWorkdir`. The merge-conflict rectifier calls `WorktreeManager.create`/`remove` with the identity and uses `storyWorktreePath` for `worktreePath`. The result handler's `hasWorktree`, `removeWorktreeDirectory` and `recordNaxOrphanOwnership` derive the identity from `ctx.feature`; `recordNaxOrphanOwnership` reads both the composed ref and the composed source branch from `naxOrphanRefName`/`storyBranchName`; the merge call passes the identity to `MergeEngine.merge`. Run initialization deletes the composed branch and logs the composed branch name. Bakeoff's `runContestant` reads the worktree path from `storyWorktreePath(projectRoot, bakeoffWorktreeId)` so the path matches the bakeoff identity passed to `create`. Two structured-log fields — `pipeline-result-handler.ts:477` (failure-log branch) and `run-initialization.ts:254` (stale-branch-log branch) — log the composed branch name. Metrics, costs and status keep the raw story ID throughout.

**Scope** — In: update the nine `src/execution/` sites and `src/bakeoff/contestant.ts:124`; update test files `test/unit/execution/pipeline-result-handler-worktree-cleanup.test.ts`, `test/unit/execution/merge-conflict-rectify.test.ts`, `test/unit/execution/iteration-runner.test.ts`, `test/unit/execution/lifecycle/run-initialization.test.ts` to read composed spellings.
Out: legacy `nax/<storyId>` branches created before this change — out of scope for the whole feature; changing `.nax-wt` directory depth; introducing branded types outside the worktree identity.

**Interface** (verbatim sites)
```
src/execution/iteration-runner.ts:90        dir            (direct join)
src/execution/parallel-batch.ts:164          dir            (direct join)
src/execution/merge-conflict-rectify.ts:272  dir            (direct join)
src/execution/pipeline-result-handler.ts:48  dir            (direct join, hasWorktree)
src/execution/pipeline-result-handler.ts:68  dir            (direct join, removeWorktreeDirectory)
src/execution/pipeline-result-handler.ts:116 branch         (direct interpolation, recordNaxOrphanOwnership source)
src/execution/pipeline-result-handler.ts:477 branch (log)   (direct interpolation)
src/execution/lifecycle/run-initialization.ts:239 branch    (direct interpolation in git argv)
src/execution/lifecycle/run-initialization.ts:254 branch(log)(direct interpolation)
src/bakeoff/contestant.ts:124                dir            (direct join)
```
The run's feature name reaches every site: `options.prd.feature` (`src/execution/parallel-batch.ts:122`), `ctx.feature` (`src/execution/iteration-runner.ts:267`, `src/execution/pipeline-result-handler.ts:209`) and `prd.feature` (`src/execution/merge-conflict-rectify.ts:281`, `src/execution/lifecycle/run-initialization.ts:208`). `PipelineContext` has no plain `feature` field, so sites reading a PRD use `prd.feature`.
acceptanceCriteria: When `runParallelBatch` runs for story `US-001` under feature `f`, the call to `WorktreeManager.create` receives the `WorktreeId` `story-f-US-001`.
When `runParallelBatch` runs for story `US-001` under feature `f`, the returned `worktreePaths` maps that story's raw ID to a path ending in `.nax-wt/story-f-US-001`.
When a story merged by `runParallelBatch` under feature `f` is returned in the `completed` list, that list contains the story keyed by its raw story ID.
When `runParallelBatch` completes for story `US-001`, the returned `storyCosts` map is keyed by the raw string `US-001`.

When the iteration runner runs a story whose worktree directory does not yet exist, with `execution.storyIsolation` set to `worktree`, the call to `WorktreeManager.create` receives the `WorktreeId` `story-f-US-001`.
When the iteration runner runs that story, the pipeline's working directory is the path ending in `.nax-wt/story-f-US-001`.

When merge-conflict rectification runs for story `US-001` under feature `f`, the call to `WorktreeManager.create` receives the `WorktreeId` `story-f-US-001` and the rectification's `worktreePath` ends in `.nax-wt/story-f-US-001`.
When the result handler checks worktree existence for story `US-001` under feature `f`, it tests the path ending in `.nax-wt/story-f-US-001`.
When the result handler removes the worktree directory for story `US-001` under feature `f`, it removes the directory ending in `.nax-wt/story-f-US-001`.

When the result handler writes the orphan-ref record for story `US-001` under feature `f`, the recorded git argv names the ref `refs/nax/orphan/story-f-US-001` and the source branch `refs/heads/nax/story-f-US-001`.
When the result handler merges story `US-001` under feature `f`, the call to `MergeEngine.merge` receives the `WorktreeId` `story-f-US-001`.
When run initialization resets story `US-001` from failed to pending under `execution.storyIsolation` set to `worktree`, the `git branch -D` argv names the branch `nax/story-f-US-001`.
When the story metrics recorded for story `US-001` are inspected, the recorded `storyId` equals the raw string `US-001`.
When the result handler emits the failure log for story `US-001` under feature `f`, the log's `branch` field equals the string `nax/story-f-US-001`.
When run initialization emits the stale-branch cleanup log for story `US-001` under feature `f`, the log's `branch` field equals the string `nax/story-f-US-001`.

When the iteration runner runs a story whose worktree directory already exists (escalation reuse), the `WorktreeManager.create` call is skipped and `effectiveWorkdir` still equals the path ending in `.nax-wt/story-f-US-001`.
When merge-conflict rectification's `worktreeManager.remove` is called for story `US-001` under feature `f`, it receives the `WorktreeId` `story-f-US-001`.
When bakeoff's `runContestant` builds the contestant worktree, the value of `context.worktree` ends in `.nax-wt/<bakeoff-identity>` matching the identity passed to `WorktreeManager.create`.

When a legacy branch named `nax/US-001` is present and a fresh failure cleanup runs for story `US-001` under feature `f`, the orphan-ref record is NOT written against the legacy branch and that legacy branch is left untouched.

routing.reasoning: Nine sites across five files under `src/execution/` plus one bakeoff site each derive an identity and route through the SSOT producers. Three sites have downstream effects (effectiveWorkdir assignment, hasWorktree gate, orphan-ref pairing with source branch) that, if missed, silently disable parts of the feature; cross-module coordination with BUG-28 evidence path and structured logs justifies test/implement/verify isolation.

outOfScope: Legacy `nax/<storyId>` branches created before this change are not detected, reused or deleted, and must be removed manually with `git branch -D`.

analysis:
Story worktrees of one git repository currently share a single ref namespace and a single worktree directory prefix (`.nax-wt/<storyId>` + branch `nax/<storyId>`). With two features running against the same repo, both run `hasWorktreeRecord()` against the same `git worktree list --porcelain` output, and Step 3 of `WorktreeManager.create()` can either fail (refused by git because the branch is checked out elsewhere) or silently delete the wrong branch via `update-ref -d` on `orphanMatchesBranch`. Fifteen production sites spell `.nax-wt`/branch/orphan-ref strings. Five reach them through a function parameter (manager.ts, merge.ts, nax-orphan-ref.ts); ten build the string directly (iteration-runner.ts:90, parallel-batch.ts:164, merge-conflict-rectify.ts:272, pipeline-result-handler.ts:48/:68/:116/:477, run-initialization.ts:239/:254, bakeoff/contestant.ts:124). Three of the direct sites fail silently if only the parameter sites are composed: iteration-runner.ts:90 sets `effectiveWorkdir` to a non-existent directory; pipeline-result-handler.ts:48 makes `hasWorktree` always return false, disabling the BUG-28 Step-3 evidence path; pipeline-result-handler.ts:116 pairs a composed ref with a raw source branch.

Key files to modify:
- src/worktree/manager.ts — `create()` and `remove()` derive dir + branch from storyId at :156-157 and :323-324; the three-step cleanup at :204-272 depends on the orphan-ref/branch naming
- src/worktree/merge.ts — `merge()` interpolates `nax/${storyId}` at :67; `mergeAll()` sorts by `topologicalSort` over raw storyIds at :165 and reads `dependencies[storyId]` at :181; `MergeResult.storyId` is matched against `workerResult.pipelinePassed.find((s) => s.id === mergeResult.storyId)` at parallel-batch.ts:286
- src/worktree/nax-orphan-ref.ts — current SSOT for the ref name, baseline param is `storyId: string`
- src/bakeoff/worktree-id.ts — sanitize + cap + hash-suffix derivation to move; bakeoff prefix and call site unchanged
- src/bakeoff/contestant.ts — passes an already-composed `deriveBakeoffWorktreeId(feature, agent)` into `create()` at :143; the structural `ContestantRunnerDeps.worktreeManager` type at :62-66 must mirror the new branded signature
- src/worktree/index.ts — barrel that re-exports `naxOrphanRefName`; US-003 imports producers through it
- src/runtime/packages.ts — :107 (`packageOverrideKey`) and :227 (`storyExecRoot`) parse `.nax-wt` paths by segment position; ACs pin their unchanged behaviour
- src/execution/* — iteration-runner.ts:90/:99, parallel-batch.ts:164, merge-conflict-rectify.ts:272, pipeline-result-handler.ts:48/:68/:116/:477, run-initialization.ts:239/:254

Risks:
- The branded `WorktreeId` narrows every parameter type at the worktree API surface — bakeoff's `ContestantRunnerDeps.worktreeManager` structural type at contestant.ts:62-66 must mirror it, the bakeoff coordinator integration test adapter must take it, and ~14 unit-test + 6 unit + 9 unit test sites must derive an identity before calling. Existing tests pin the literal `nax/US-001` strings, which must now be derived.
- `MergeResult.storyId` stays raw (it is the join key into `pipelinePassed`, `storyCosts`, and `prd.userStories`); `StoryDependencies` stays keyed by raw story IDs so `topologicalSort` and the failed-dep skip resolve.
- Depth of `.nax-wt/<id>` must stay at two path segments — deepening breaks `packageOverrideKey` (packages.ts:107) and `storyExecRoot` (packages.ts:227), which parse by position and would silently derive the wrong package key (nax#2111 defect class).
- A legacy `nax/<storyId>` branch from before this change is not recognised as this feature's orphan and is left untouched; no automatic sweep, to avoid force-deleting a branch another checkout may still hold. The orphan-ref ownership record must NOT fire for such a legacy branch.
- A new gate script that is not reachable from `check:all-without-biome` is itself caught by `scripts/check-gate-reachability.ts`; the script and its `package.json` registration land together.
- An empty feature name yields `story--<storyId>` (tolerated; bakeoff already passes `options.feature ?? ""`).

Architecture decisions:
- One producer per spelling: `storyWorktreePath`, `storyBranchName`, `naxOrphanRefName`. All thirteen sites go through one of them.
- Branded `WorktreeId` (`string` with a unique type tag), produced only by `deriveStoryWorktreeId` or `deriveBakeoffWorktreeId`. Shared sanitize/cap/hash-suffix moves out of `src/bakeoff/worktree-id.ts` into `src/worktree/worktree-id.ts`; bakeoff delegates or re-exports to keep its `bakeoff-` namespace disjoint.
- Static gate `scripts/check-worktree-id-ssot.ts` scans `src/**/*.{ts,tsx}` for open-coded `.nax-wt` path segments and `nax/` branch strings, with an explicit allowlist (worktree-id.ts itself; packages.ts:109 and :237 which compare the segment; gitignore.ts:62 ignore entry; review/runner/index.ts:247 ignore regex; precheck/checks-git.ts:55 porcelain-status regex; precheck/checks-warnings.ts:235 ignore entry; bakeoff/preflight.ts:18 composing the separate `nax/bakeoff-` branch namespace) and a per-line `// nax-worktree-id-allow: <reason>` escape hatch mirroring `check-feature-dir-ssot.ts`.
- Read-only dependencies verified at shape: `validateStoryId` (src/prd/validate.ts), `_worktreeManagerDeps.gitWithTimeout` (manager.ts:19), `_iterationRunnerDeps.existsSync` (iteration-runner.ts:325), `_parallelBatchDeps.createWorktreeManager` (parallel-batch.ts:100), `_resultHandlerDeps.spawn` (pipeline-result-handler.ts), `packageOverrideKey` (packages.ts:107), `storyExecRoot` (packages.ts:227). Feature name reaches every site: `options.prd.feature` (parallel-batch.ts:122), `ctx.feature` (iteration-runner.ts:267, pipeline-result-handler.ts:209), `prd.feature` (merge-conflict-rectify.ts:281, run-initialization.ts:208).

Migration: tests that pin literal `nax/US-001` strings derive through `storyBranchName`; tests that pin `.nax-wt/US-001` paths derive through `storyWorktreePath`; tests that pin `refs/nax/orphan/US-001` derive through `naxOrphanRefName`. No data migration — legacy branches are out of scope.

Stories are sequenced by dependency: US-001 (identity module + gate) → US-002 (worktree API takes identity) → US-003 (every execution site derives identity).
outOfScope: Legacy `nax/<storyId>` branches created before this feature are not detected, reused or deleted, and must be removed manually with `git branch -D`; an automatic sweep would have to force-delete a branch a pre-upgrade run in another checkout may still hold.

Changing the `.nax-wt/<id>` worktree directory to more than two path segments is not part of this feature.
Changing bakeoff's composition inputs or its `bakeoff-` prefix is not part of this feature; only `deriveBakeoffWorktreeId`'s return type narrows.

Two concurrent runs of the **same** feature against one repository still collide on `nax/story-<feature>-US-001`; serializing them is the feature lock delivered by the `project-identity-run-locking` feature, not this one.
Matching project identity by git remote, and the `RUN_NAME_COLLISION` behaviour of `claimProjectIdentity`, are delivered by the `project-identity-run-locking` feature.
Run locking of any kind is delivered by the `project-identity-run-locking` feature.
Introducing branded types anywhere outside the worktree identity is not part of this feature.

An empty feature name yields the identity `story--<storyId>` and is accepted; rejecting it is not part of this feature, because `src/bakeoff/contestant.ts:100` already tolerates an empty feature through `options.feature ?? ""`.
